title: test/vectors/ccp_select_channel_endianness.json: Description incorrectly states output range for n_channels < 3
description:
The description claims 'Output range is [1, n_channels-1] inclusive' but the actual formula with max() clamp produces range [1, max(n_channels-1, 2)]. For n_channels=2, the stated range is [1,1] but the formula produces [1,2]. The test vector n_channels_clamped_to_2 correctly expects channel=2, contradicting the description. Implementations validating against the stated bounds would incorrectly reject valid outputs.

Fix suggestion: Change the description to: 'Output range is [1, max(n_channels-1, 2)] inclusive, which equals [1, n_channels-1] for n_channels >= 3.'
